Primary public form archetype, including labels and validation semantics.

findings.summary: The fixed dark palette does not respond to the user’s colour-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: Light and dark emulation screenshots are visually identical, while the DOM reports color-scheme: normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() to provide preference-driven light and dark palettes.

findings.summary: Route changes do not use view transitions.
findings.evidence: The UI probe found no view-transition CSS and navigation is conventional full-document replacement.
findings.suggestedFix: Add same-origin cross-document view transitions with a safe fallback and disable non-essential motion under reduced motion.

findings.summary: The very long listing has no position-aware navigation or progress cue.
findings.evidence: Layout measured a 16,547px mobile page; screenshots and DOM show static chrome with no scroll progress or scroll-state treatment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a compact sticky header or progress/return control that reacts to scroll state.

findings.summary: Navigation and in-page state changes provide no attention cue.
findings.evidence: No view-transition/highlight/scroll-marker treatment was found, and card links have empty visible text in the DOM probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional transitions or persistent current-state markers and descriptive card link text.

findings.summary: A full-screen age-verification interstitial obscures every primary content page on load.
findings.evidence: Mobile and desktop screenshots show a fixed blurred overlay covering the content before interaction.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep legally required verification, but use a focused, accessible dialog with the minimum interruption and a reliable continuation path.

findings.summary: The age gate is an ad-hoc fixed div rather than a semantic modal dialog.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS shows .ageverif_overlay/.ageverif_banner fixed divs; the primary action is an anchor with onclick and no href.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement the gate with <dialog>, explicit labelling, focus containment, and a real button for the verification action.

findings.summary: Advertising and promotional chrome competes heavily with the content.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 145 requests and the DOM contains several ad-network promotions mixed among listing cards; screenshots show the content behind the gate.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce ad slots, label promotions clearly, and defer non-essential ad widgets until after the core content.

findings.summary: Components rely on viewport CSS rather than container-aware adaptation.
findings.evidence: The UI probe found zero @container rules, while reused listing/ad components are constrained through fixed and viewport media-query CSS.
findings.suggestedFix: Give reusable cards and widgets containment and adapt them with size container queries.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and many targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The first focused action computed outline-style:none; 50 of 115 interactive elements measured below 44px in one dimension.
findings.suggestedFix: Add strong :focus-visible styles and enlarge or space small touch targets to at least 44x44 CSS px where practical.

findings.summary: The primary browse-to-watch journey is blocked by an external age-verification dependency.
findings.evidence: Homepage and detail screenshots remain behind the gate; activating Verify My Age produced an empty fixed panel in the category capture rather than completing the journey.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a robust verification handoff with loading, failure, retry and return states, then restore the requested URL.

findings.summary: Verification and form flows lack useful recovery states.
findings.evidence: The attempted verification showed a blank modal panel; the contact form marks no field required and provides no visible inline validation before submission.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose loading/error states with retry/cancel and add post-interaction, accessible validation to forms.

findings.summary: Measured mobile loading misses good LCP and CLS thresholds.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 3.4s and CLS 0.204; trace corroborated 2.03s LCP in a separate run.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve space for late content and prioritize the real LCP resource while deferring non-critical third parties.

findings.summary: The landing page performs a heavy, blocking network load.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 145 requests and 6.62MB transferred, including eight parser-blocking stylesheets and six classic scripts without async/defer confirmed by the platform probe.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline critical CSS, defer non-critical scripts/styles, lazy-load below-fold media, and apply effective caching.

findings.summary: Substantial unused third-party JavaScript ships on initial load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 250KiB unused JS, including analytics and repeated ad-provider payloads with 45% to 94% waste.
findings.suggestedFix: Load analytics/ad libraries conditionally and remove duplicate ad-provider execution.

findings.summary: Controls and images lack accessible names or alternatives.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt; the image audit found eight missing alt attributes, including the menu icon and age-gate icon.
findings.suggestedFix: Give controls accessible names and meaningful images alt text; mark decorative images with empty alt.

findings.summary: Important text and the verification action fail minimum contrast.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured 2.83:1 on Verify My Age and 3.06:1 on repeated metadata text, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/surface tokens to meet WCAG AA and verify all interaction states.

findings.summary: The age gate does not provide robust keyboard semantics or visible focus.
findings.evidence: The gate is a generic div and its focused action has outline:none; the action is an anchor without href.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a labelled dialog, a button, managed initial/return focus, and visible :focus-visible styling.

findings.summary: The page disables zoom and video lacks text alternatives.
findings.evidence: Viewport content includes maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no; the detail probe found videos with no <track> captions; 50 targets are undersized.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user scaling, provide captions/transcripts, and enlarge touch targets.

findings.summary: The page throws an uncaught JavaScript exception during load.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse captured “$(...).nivoSlider is not a function” in custom.js line 206.
findings.suggestedFix: Load the slider dependency before initialization or guard/remove the stale initializer.

findings.summary: Images are not dimensioned or delivered responsively.
findings.evidence: The image audit found all 54 images missing width/height, 47 below-fold images not lazy, 46 without srcset and 53 legacy-format assets.
findings.suggestedFix: Set intrinsic dimensions, use responsive srcset/sizes, lazy loading, and modern formats.

findings.summary: Several actions and cards are not crawlable or descriptive links.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed crawlable-anchors; Verify My Age is an anchor without href and the link probe recorded many empty-text detail links and # actions.
findings.suggestedFix: Use buttons for actions and descriptive <a href> links for destinations.

findings.summary: Video detail pages lack structured and social-preview metadata.
findings.evidence: The detail probe found no JSON-LD, Open Graph tags or hreflang despite a clearly identified video entity.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate VideoObject JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter metadata matching visible content.

findings.summary: The HTTPS response omits baseline security headers and sets weak cookies.
findings.evidence: Headers found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame protection, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy; cookies found three non-Secure and all six SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP, HSTS, nosniff, frame-ancestors, referrer/permissions policies, and Secure/Lax cookies where cross-site use is unnecessary.

findings.summary: The page sends a large tracking and advertising footprint before consent.
findings.evidence: Tracker capture found 16 third-party origins including Google Analytics and Yandex/Webvisor; HAR attributes 6.61MB of 6.62MB to third-party origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise vendors and data, delay non-essential tracking until valid consent, and batch sparse analytics.

findings.summary: Failure handling is obscured by the same mandatory gate.
findings.evidence: A genuine HTTP 404 response still renders the full-screen verification overlay, hiding any recovery content; verification itself produced an empty panel.
findings.suggestedFix: Render clear 404/network recovery before non-essential scripts and ensure the gate has timeout, error and retry UI.

findings.summary: The document does not declare its language or direction.
findings.evidence: UI and platform probes both report empty html.lang and html.dir.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="en" and use logical CSS properties so translated or bidirectional layouts remain robust.

findings.summary: Promotional links are visually mixed into content and use misleading destinations.
findings.evidence: The link probe shows local-dating and AI promotions whose href resolves to the homepage, alongside separate ad-network redirects, without clear ad semantics.
findings.suggestedFix: Clearly label sponsored content, use truthful destinations, and separate promotions from editorial results.

findings.summary: The contact form does not express required fields or post-interaction validation.
findings.evidence: The contact probe found Name, Email and Message all required=false and no demonstrated inline error model.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark required fields, use appropriate input types, and validate after interaction with accessible error announcements.

findings.summary: The contact and search inputs omit useful autocomplete semantics.
findings.evidence: The contact probe found empty autocomplete values and the homepage search explicitly uses autocomplete=off.
findings.suggestedFix: Use email/name autocomplete tokens and avoid disabling autocomplete on ordinary search/input flows.

findings.summary: The image payload is broadly unoptimised.
findings.evidence: Image audit found 53 legacy-format images, 46 without responsive sources, 47 eager below-fold images and 54 without intrinsic dimensions.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, srcset/sizes, intrinsic dimensions and below-fold lazy loading.

findings.summary: Initial load fetches multiple promotional video previews and analytics work.
findings.evidence: HAR transferred 4.47MB as XHR/fetch, led by five third-party MP4 files, before the user reached core content.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not fetch preview video until visible or requested; deprioritize background analytics and ads.

findings.summary: Third-party media dominates the page budget.
findings.evidence: HAR measured 6.61MB third-party transfer and 144 of 145 requests; five ad-network MP4 previews account for most bytes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party/media budget, defer previews, reduce vendors, and cache only media that provides direct user value.

taskList.title: Make the legally required age-verification journey semantic, accessible and recoverable
Deploy baseline security headers and privacy-safe cookie defaults
Cut third-party tracking, preview-media and ad payloads before consent

Reserve image space and modernise responsive image delivery
Make promotions honest and links crawlable/descriptive
Add humane contact validation and input assistance
